name: io.github.vish288/mcp-gitlab
description: GitLab MCP server for MCP 2026-07-28: projects, MRs, pipelines, CI/CD, approvals, issues

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitLab personal access token (token mode; also accepts GITLAB_PAT, GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN, or GITLAB_API_TOKEN)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: Authentication mode: token (default) or oauth (OAuth 2.1 proxy; streamable-http only)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Application ID of the GitLab OAuth app (oauth mode)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Secret of the GitLab OAuth app (oauth mode)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public URL of this server, no trailing slash (oauth mode); redirect URI is <base>/auth/callback

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Space-separated GitLab scopes required on every request (oauth mode; default api)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_JWT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: FastMCP JWT signing key, >=32 random chars (oauth mode; defaults to one derived from the client secret)
